basics.name: Aruzhan Zhamalbek
basics.label: Machine Learning Researcher & Engineer
basics.summary: Machine Learning master's student working across distributed ML systems, computational biology, numerical methods, and reproducible scientific computing.

highlights: Develop reproducible Nextflow pipelines on HPC for TB-scale ENCODE regulatory-genomics data.
Build data-lineage and validation checks across datasets, configurations, and downstream model inputs.
Extract high-dimensional signal features and flag sequencing-track anomalies before model training.
Evaluate and distill multi-omic foundation models for cancer prognosis, using held-out patients to assess how much prognostic signal a 20-gene model retains.
Contribute to DeepOmic Bench, which compares up to 56 models per dataset with clinical baselines on frozen splits across 4 tasks, 11 datasets, and 12,627 unique patients.
Co-author five ESMO AI & Digital Oncology Congress posters and two accepted San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium posters on model transfer, biomarker prediction, and benchmarking.
Curated and harmonized biomedical interaction datasets for Interactome-FM, standardizing knowledge-graph metadata, schemas, cloud paths, and provenance.
Integrated biological reasoning signals by mapping genes, drugs, pathways, regulatory interactions, protein complexes, and ligand–receptor relationships across heterogeneous sources.
Built and validated graph artifacts with 132,498 nodes, 32.5M edges, and 56 edge types using reproducible GCS and Kubeflow workflows.
Optimized FastQC, Trimmomatic, BWA, and GATK pipelines, improving throughput by 10% across 200+ datasets.
Applied PCA, clustering, and population-diversity metrics to identify latent genomic structure and adaptation signals.
Automated high-throughput sequencing QC and analysis with Python and R; selected as a top-seven UGSRP Symposium project.
Built statistical signal-to-noise analyses for CRISPR-edit validation.
Improved operational throughput by 25% through workflow automation.
Built exploratory analyses and dashboards for AI-assisted diagnostics initiatives.
